title: Introducing the Metriport plugin for ChatGPT
summary: Metriport’s ChatGPT plugin lets healthcare teams ask about patients in plain language and get evidence-linked answers from full histories.
body_markdown:
As part of OpenAI's[expansion of its healthcare capabilities](https://openai.com/index/more-ways-to-move-care-forward-with-chatgpt-for-healthcare/) , Metriport is bringing comprehensive patient medical histories directly into ChatGPT.


Healthcare teams can now use ChatGPT to ask questions about their patients and get answers informed by the comprehensive medical histories available through Metriport.


The Metriport plugin for ChatGPT combines ChatGPT's reasoning capabilities with clean, standardized patient records, making it easier to find, review, and analyze clinical information using plain language.


Metriport connects to national health information exchanges, EHRs, pharmacies, labs, and other clinical sources to assemble longitudinal patient histories. Records are consolidated, deduplicated, and standardized into a unified FHIR data model, giving ChatGPT a solid foundation to work from.


## What you can do


From a single lab result to a patient's entire medical history, you can ask highly specific questions or explore broader, more complex ones.


#### Get the latest clinical context


To answer your question, ChatGPT and Metriport will search external sources such as health information exchanges, pharmacies, and labs, then update your EHR with the new records.


#### Ask complex clinical questions


ChatGPT reviews the findings, connects the evidence, and provides an answer, with the evidence attached.


#### Find details buried in patient histories


Ask about past screenings, specialist visits, procedures, or individual lab results.


#### Investigate trends


Review changes in lab values, medications, or clinical findings over time.


#### Summarize medical histories


Turn hundreds of records into a concise summary tailored to your question.


For questions that require more than a simple lookup, ChatGPT can work across different records, make inferences, and provide clear answers with links to the supporting evidence.


## Built for healthcare


Clinical answers need to be accurate, supported by evidence, and verifiable. Patient information also needs to remain protected.


The plugin links findings to their original records so clinicians can review the evidence themselves. It also respects each user's access permissions, retrieving patient information only when an authorized user makes a request.


The plugin is designed to assist clinical teams, not make decisions for them. It reads and analyzes records but doesn't place orders, send messages, or make clinical decisions.


## Getting started


The ChatGPT plugin is available to Metriport customers now. Add it from ChatGPT's plugin[directory](https://openai.com/business/plugins/metriport/) , sign in with your Metriport account, and we'll review your use case before providing access. Then you're set to give ChatGPT your toughest clinical questions.
